evidenceBasis.classic.m7: every knob-only arm so far stays at or above the WARN line: round 1 (41001-41400, STD 51.75): BASE 61.5, M7_A 0.7/0.6 57.75, M7_B 0.65/0.55 60.25, M7_C 0.6/0.5 58.25; round 2 (57001-57400, STD 51.2): BASE 59.0, M7_D 0.5/0.5 62.5 (vs BASE +3.5, -3.1..10.1), M7_E earlyGame standard 64.5, M7_F (D + earlyGame standard) 63.0 (vs D +0.5). On the two fresh blocks, neutralising the knobs did not measurably lower m7 (round 2: M7_D - BASE +3.5, -3.1..10.1). The knob study's K / C were estimated on the block on which G-A8 selected m7 (25001-25400) and did not replicate: the identical config NEUTRAL_classic.m7 = M7_D (same fingerprint) gave 55.75 there (vs std +1.0) and 62.5 on 57001-57400 (vs std +11.25, 4.7..17.8), a cross-block difference of about 15 pp (z about 3.1); FULL fell from 67.25 to 61.5 / 59.0 (selection on the G-A8 block). So the cross-block spread of one and the same arm is larger than binomial, the confirmRisk figures are lower bounds, and this round screens content groups both on std knobs and with the shipped knobs kept. Content groups that reach the engine (toEngineTactic / toEngineTacticIdentity): (1) objectives.towerPriority 0.6 (aggro +0.003 per lane, siegeBias +0.1); (2) macro.tempo fast (gankInterval 32 s vs 45 s, invadeWithMid true); (3) lanePlan top / mid / adc aggressive (laneOffset +0.05 per lane; the gank weights 1.7 / 1.7 / 1.7 are uniform and therefore equal to std after normalisation); (4) the invade group: lanePlan.jungle invade and objectives.invadePriority 0.8 (invadeChance 0.8 vs std 0.1); (5) macro.earlyGame aggressive (phaseEngage; screened in round 2: no detectable increment, F - D +0.5). vision.enemyJungle and the dragon / baron priorities below std are not screened (enemyJungle is not read by the engine; lower objective joins are not a plausible source of strength). Cross-template hint from the committed G-A8 (25001-25400, std 54.8; descriptive, different seeds): v2.three_lane_pressure (three lanes aggressive, fast tempo, tower 0.6, invade 0.15, 0.7/0.6) 60.3 STOP; classic.m1 (mid aggressive, fast, tower 0.9) 60.3 STOP; v2.jungle_invasion (jungle invade, mid aggressive, fast, invade 0.35 => invadeChance 0.7) 53.3 no flag. This points at the lanes / tempo groups rather than the invasion, but it is not used to order or select the arms

multiplicity and power (review round 1 #5): 12 arms on one seed block, 9 m7 candidates, unadjusted 95% intervals. Round 2's paired differences had sd 0.66-0.69 (almost no within-seed correlation) => SE about 3.35 pp and a paired MDE about 9.3 pp (80% power, two-sided 0.05) for each candidate vs its compareTo arm, so single-group increments below about 9 pp are not resolved. If every candidate's true rate were 0.60, the chance that at least one of 9 shows < 0.57 (BORDERLINE) is about 0.65 and <= 0.55 (SELECTED) about 0.17 (independent approximation): a selection here is weak evidence and the confirmatory G-A8 decides

confirmatory risk for every candidate: the probability of >= 0.57 or <= 0.43 on 400 confirmatory seeds if the screening estimate were the true rate (normal approximation; winner's curse makes the real risk larger for a selected arm)
